school: 明代'以幻笔行世情'的小说体系构建者：以《西游记》把官僚制度整个搬进神魔世界（批判外包给镜子），把修行量化为九九八十一难的可审计阶梯，以谐谑降格神圣、把最危险的政治命题放进玩笑，以'心猿'把抽象心识铸成可叙事的角色，用互补缺陷的团队让八十一难自我供能，以'妖有后台'的情节规律完成无评论的结构分析，以有解除条件的紧箍咒写透约束制度，用三根扣件串起可局部增删的百回珠串，让三教在同一情节机器里分工协作——他是把最不现实的包装做成最精确社会观察的人
historical_significance: 吴承恩（约1500-1582），字汝忠，号射阳山人，淮安府山阳县人；自幼敏慧，'博览群书，为诗文下笔立成'，但科场蹭蹬，中年才补得岁贡生；嘉靖四十五年（1566）任长兴县丞，因不愿逢迎上司拂袖而去，后补授荆王府纪善，不久告归；一生最重要的作品是百回本《西游记》——中国神魔小说的巅峰：它把明代官僚制度的运转规则原样搬进天庭龙宫地府，把修行情节化为'九九八十一难'的可数配额，以'心猿'命名让心性修养成为可叙事的角色弧线，以'妖有后台'的重复情节规律完成对权贵庇护结构的无评论分析，以谐谑笔法让'皇帝轮流做，明年到我家'这样最危险的命题以玩笑抵达读者；此外著有《禹鼎志》（已佚）与《射阳先生存稿》；他晚年居淮安，约万历十年卒——他证明：一个科场失意者可以用'游戏笔墨'完成一个时代最精确的社会解剖，并让这解剖以童话的形态抵达每一个人
historical_significance_en: Wu Cheng'en (c. 1500-1582), courtesy name Ruzhong, sobriquet Master of the Sheyang, a native of Shanyang in Huai'an; quick from childhood, said to read all books and compose verse at a stroke, yet he stumbled through the examinations, taking the annual tribute student's rank only in middle years; in 1566 he served as vice-magistrate of Changxing, left rather than flatter his superiors, was later secretary to a prince, and retired again. His great work is the hundred-chapter Journey to the West, the summit of the Chinese novel of gods and demons: it carries the operating rules of Ming bureaucracy whole into the courts of heaven, the dragon palaces and the underworld; turns cultivation into a countable quota of eighty-one trials; names the mind 'the mind-monkey' so the taming of the heart becomes a narratable arc; lets the recurring law of 'the demon with a patron' perform, without one comment, an analysis of the structure of patronage; and by jest lets the most dangerous sentence in the book — 'let the emperorship take its turn; next year it comes to my house' — arrive as a joke. He wrote also the lost Yu Ding Zhi and the surviving Drafts of Master Sheyang. He died at Huai'an around the tenth year of Wanli — proof that an examination failure may perform, in idle pen, the most exact anatomy of his age, and that the anatomy may reach everyone in the dress of a fairy tale
unique_thinking: 吴承恩思维模式的独特性在于五条主线的合成：第一，'镜像批判'——他不写檄文而造镜子，把要批判的制度原样搬进一个免责的虚构世界，让荒谬在'人人认出'中自行显形；第二，'配额化的成长'——他把玄妙的修行改造成有总数、有清单、有验收的八十一难，成长第一次成为可审计的工程；第三，'谐谑的火候'——笑声被用作精确的剂量工具，越危险的判断越以玩笑形式送达，暧昧性同时是武器与护甲；第四，'具象的心智'——'心猿意马'这个古老比喻被他铸成一个有人格的角色，不可见的心理过程从此可观察、可讨论、可传承；第五，'规律即论据'——'妖有后台'不靠人物发议论，而靠情节规则的重复完成结构分析，文本不评论、只排列；五线共同指向一件事：把最严肃的批判装进最轻盈的形式，让它跑得比任何禁令都远
unique_thinking_en: The distinctiveness of Wu Cheng'en's thinking is a synthesis of five lines. First, critique by mirror — he writes no manifesto but builds a looking glass, carrying the institution to be criticized unchanged into a disclaiming fictional world where absurdity shows itself in everyone's recognition. Second, growth by quota — mystical cultivation remade as eighty-one trials with a total, a list, and an audit; growth becomes for the first time an accountable engineering. Third, the dose of laughter — humor handled as a precise instrument, the more dangerous the judgment the more surely it travels as a joke, its ambiguity at once weapon and armor. Fourth, the mind made concrete — the old figure of the mind-monkey cast as a character with person and history, invisible mental life become observable, discussable, transmissible. Fifth, the law as argument — 'the demon with a patron' needs no speech-making; the repetition of a plot rule performs the structural analysis, the text arranging and never commenting. The five lines share one direction: to load the gravest critique into the lightest form, and let it run farther than any prohibition
civilization_zh: 明代的淮安与荆王府纪年——一个在科场蹭蹬半生的人，把才华交给了一个'不安分'的体裁：他中年才补得岁贡生，长兴县丞任上因不肯折腰而拂袖，补授荆王府纪善不久又告归；功名上他是失意者，书斋里他却建成了中国人想象力最大的一座府库——百回本《西游记》；他把科场的荒诞写成天庭的会典，把权贵家奴写成有后台的妖魔，把心性修养写成一只猴子的四百年；他不曾在奏疏里直谏一个字，却让每一个读'皇帝轮流做'的读者心里一动；他没有留下显赫的官衔，留下的是文学史上被翻印最多的想象力——一个用玩笑完成了最严肃批判的人
civilization_en: Huai'an and the princedom secretariat, the Ming — a man stumbles half a life through the examinations and gives his talent to an unseemly genre: past middle age he takes only the annual tribute student's rank, throws up the post of county vice-magistrate at Changxing rather than bow, serves briefly as secretary in a prince's establishment and retires again. In career a failure; in his study he built the greatest treasury of imagination in the language, the hundred-chapter Journey to the West. He wrote the absurdity of the examinations as the statutes of heaven's court, the great houses' retainers as demons with patrons, the cultivation of the heart as a monkey's four hundred years. Not one word of frank remonstrance did he put in a memorial, yet every reader of 'let the emperorship take its turn' feels the pulse move. He left no splendid titles; he left the most reprinted imagination in the history of letters — a man who performed the gravest critique in the form of a joke

cross_references.description_zh: 吴承恩与曾公亮同为'把庞杂经验整理成可运行体系'的工程师：曾公亮把边防武备整理成可查检的《武经总要》条目体系，吴承恩把修心成道的漫长志业整理成可审计的八十一难配额；两人都相信'庞杂之物必须被结构化才能被传承'，都在体系里内建了检索与验收机制（武经的总目提要/取经的难簿）；差异在于曾公亮整理的是国家武备的实然，吴承恩整理的是心性修养的应然——一个做成官修兵书，一个做成神魔小说。
cross_references.description_en: Wu Cheng'en and Zeng Gongliang are both engineers who reduced vast experience to a running system: Zeng organized the armory of border defense into the searchable entries of the Essentials of the Military Classics; Wu organized the long vocation of cultivating the heart into the auditable quota of eighty-one trials. Both believed the vast must be structured to be transmitted, and both built retrieval and acceptance into their systems — the summaries of the Essentials, the ledger of trials on the road. The difference: Zeng structured what the state's arms are, Wu what the heart's becoming ought to be — one an official military compendium, the other a novel of gods and demons.

cross_references.description_zh: 吴承恩与汤显祖同为晚明'以虚构世界安置真实价值'的体系构建者：汤显祖为'情'立法、让杜丽娘因梦而死又因梦而生，吴承恩为'心'立法、让孙悟空从大闹天宫走到斗战胜佛；两人都把主观世界的运动（情/心）铸成完整的叙事体系，都让虚构承担了现实不允许直说的批判；差异在于汤显祖的批判向下扎根于情之不可压制，吴承恩的批判向上翻越到制度之必须被笑——一个为人心争本体地位，一个为笑声争政治豁免。
cross_references.description_en: Wu Cheng'en and Tang Xianzu are both late-Ming builders of systems that house real value in fictional worlds: Tang legislated for feeling, letting Du Liniang die of a dream and live by it; Wu legislated for the heart, walking Sun Wukong from havoc in heaven to buddhahood. Both cast the movements of the inner world — feeling, mind — as complete narrative systems, and both made fiction bear the critique reality would not permit said straight. The difference: Tang's critique roots downward in the inexpressibility of feeling; Wu's climbs upward to the institution that must be laughed at — one winning ontological standing for the heart, the other political immunity for laughter.

cross_references.description_zh: 吴承恩与董仲舒代表'对待秩序'的两个极端：董仲舒以'天'为秩序立法，天人感应让制度获得宇宙论担保，人须俯身顺应；吴承恩让'天'整个变成一间官僚衙门，玉帝会悚惧、佛祖要打点，宇宙论担保被谐谑拆解成人间笑料——董仲舒为秩序辩护，吴承恩为秩序除魅；对照命题：同一个'天'，可以被建成权威的来源，也可以被建成讽刺的舞台。
cross_references.description_en: Wu Cheng'en and Dong Zhongshu mark the two extremes in treating order: Dong took heaven as order's legislator, the responses between heaven and man giving institutions their cosmological surety, and man must bow and conform; Wu made heaven a whole bureau — an emperor who quakes, a Buddha who takes tips — the cosmological surety dissolved by jest into human comedy. Dong pleads for order; Wu disenchants it. The contrast: the same heaven may be built into the source of authority or the stage of satire.

cross_references.description_zh: 吴承恩与关汉卿同为元明'借用舞台性'的批判者，方向相反：关汉卿把批判直接搬进人间公堂——窦娥的血溅白练是即时的、有姓名的控诉；吴承恩把批判整个外包给神魔世界——人间没有受害者只有镜像；关汉卿的批判燃烧而短促（一折一命），吴承恩的批判弥散而长命（四百年无害通行）；对照命题：直斥需要勇气与代价，镜像需要机巧与耐心——讽刺的两条路线在两人身上各走到底。
cross_references.description_en: Wu Cheng'en and Guan Hanqing are both masters of borrowed theatricality, in opposite directions: Guan carries the critique straight into the human courtroom — Dou E's blood on the white silk an immediate, named accusation; Wu outsources the critique whole to the world of gods and demons — no victims on earth, only a mirror. Guan's critique burns short, one act, one life; Wu's diffuses long, four hundred years passing without harm. The contrast: direct charge takes courage and pays cost; the mirror takes craft and patience — the two routes of satire each driven to its end.

modes.name_en: The Method of Gods as Bureaucracy
modes.category: 认知方法/以超自然秩序映射人间制度
modes.domain_zh: 《西游记》的天庭不是信仰对象，而是一面镜子：玉帝有朝会、有品级、有请示批复，龙宫有公文往来，地府有户籍勾销，连如来座下也要论资排辈——吴承恩把明代官僚制度的一切运转规则原样搬进神魔世界；这个映射的深意在于：第一，批判被外包——对科层制文牍主义、裙带关系的讽刺，借'天界'说出而不直接指涉朝政，作者得以畅言而读者人人意会；第二，解释力被放大——孙悟空大闹天宫之所以读来痛快，正因为天庭的颟顸推诿与读者亲历的官场经验严丝合缝，神话获得现实的密度；第三，体制的荒谬在异界更显荒谬——天兵十万拿不下一个妖猴，需要西天如来救场，'超自然'反而暴露了'制度'的无能；他证明：批判现实最安全也最锋利的方式，是把现实原样翻译成一个对方无法申辩的虚构世界
modes.domain_en: The heaven of Journey to the West is not an object of worship but a mirror: the Jade Emperor holds courts, keeps ranks, receives memorials and issues rescripts; the dragon palaces exchange official papers; the underworld keeps registers and strikes out names; even beneath the Buddha one stands by seniority — Wu Cheng'en carried every operating rule of Ming bureaucracy whole into the world of gods and demons. The point of the mapping: first, critique by proxy — satire of red tape and patronage is spoken of 'heaven' and never of the court, so the author speaks freely and every reader understands; second, explanatory power magnified — the havoc in heaven reads so freely because heaven's muddle and passing of blame fits the reader's own knowledge of office to the seam, and the myth takes on the density of the real; third, absurdity made plainer abroad — a hundred thousand heavenly soldiers cannot take one monkey, and the Western Heaven must be called in: the supernatural exposes the incompetence of the institution. He proved: the safest and sharpest way to criticize the real is to translate it whole into a fictional world its subject cannot answer
modes.source_chapter: 《西游记》第四回'官封弼马心何足 名注齐天意未宁'；第六回观音赴会问原因；天庭/龙宫/地府官僚体系描写
modes.key_quote_zh: 天庭有朝会、有品级、有批复——神魔世界是人间官僚制度的完整镜像
modes.key_quote_en: "Heaven holds courts, keeps ranks, issues rescripts — the world of gods is a full mirror of human bureaucracy."
process_zh: 选定要批判的现实制度，逐条列出它的运转规则：朝会、品级、公文、请托——清单越具体，镜像越有力
把规则原样搬进一个超自然世界：不给规则做美化或简化，荒谬感来自'照搬'本身
让虚构世界跑出一个极端案例：一个个体挑战整个体制，体制的每一处推诿都因此显形
保留可辨认的对应物：读者必须能从天庭认出朝廷——映射的批判力来自'人人意会'而非点破
process_en: Choose the real institution to criticize and list its operating rules one by one — courts, ranks, papers, patronage; the more concrete the list, the stronger the mirror
Carry the rules unchanged into a supernatural world: neither beautified nor simplified; the absurdity comes from the carrying itself
Run an extreme case in the fictional world: one individual against the whole institution, and every place the institution passes the buck shows itself
Keep the counterpart recognizable: the reader must see the court in heaven — the critique works by everyone's silent recognition, not by being said outright
representative_cases_zh: 孙悟空被封'弼马温'：御马监正堂品的荒诞性——体制给造反者一个最小的官职就算安抚，讽刺的是安抚逻辑本身
凤仙郡三年无雨：玉帝因一次冒犯设米山面山金锁为难一郡百姓——神圣权力被写成滥用权力的科层报复
阿傩伽叶'要人事'：传经也要打点，佛门圣地的最后一环也要塞 Tango——映射一路铺到体制的最上层
representative_cases_en: Sun Wukong made 'protector of horses': the absurdity of the title — the institution soothes a rebel with its smallest post; what is satirized is the logic of soothing itself

Three rainless years at Fengxian: the Jade Emperor, for one offense, sets a mountain of rice, a mountain of flour and a golden lock against a whole prefecture — sacred power written as bureaucratic spite
Ananda and Kasyapa asking for 'the gift': even the handing over of the scriptures wants a tip — the mapping runs to the very top of the institution
modern_applications_zh: 组织诊断的'异界翻译法'：把本公司流程原样画成一个虚构王国的运行规则，让管理者从'异界'一眼看清本组织的荒谬——距离产生批判力
讽刺性写作的安全通道：时评、漫画、内网吐槽都可以用'完整镜像+可辨认对应物'结构——不点名而人人意会，表达力与安全性同时最大化
产品隐喻设计：用'天庭科层'式的世界观给复杂系统做用户教育（权限、审批、工单）——用户在虚构里学会真实系统
modern_applications_en: Organizational diagnosis by translation to a strange world: draw your company's processes as the operating rules of an imaginary kingdom, and management sees the absurdity of its own organization at a glance — distance makes critique

A safe channel for satirical writing: commentary, caricature, internal complaint — the structure of a full mirror with recognizable counterparts names no one and is understood by everyone, maximizing force and safety at once
Metaphor design for products: teach complex systems — permissions, approvals, tickets — through a heaven-with-ranks worldview; users learn the real system inside a fiction

modes.name_en: The Method of the Eighty-One Trials
modes.category: 方法论/把成长量化为可数的磨难阶梯
modes.domain_zh: 取经路被吴承恩精确设计为'九九八十一难'：磨难不是随机的障碍，而是一个有总数的配额——观音菩萨查看难簿发现只有八十难，还须补上一难才成正果；这个设计的深意：第一，成长被量化——修行不是玄妙的顿悟而是可数、可审计的阶梯，差一难都不行；第二，磨难被序列化——每一难有独立的对手、独立的解法（孙悟空搬救兵、菩萨收服、主人认领），难的类型覆盖贪、嗔、痴、惰、疑，像一份刻意配齐的课表；第三，最后一难安排在通天河——经已取到仍要落水，暗示'完成'本身也是考验；第四，难簿可查——磨难的账目是公开的，谁也逃不掉、谁也不能跳级；他证明：把一项漫长志业切成有总数、有清单、有验收的磨难序列，是从'修心'到'成事'最可靠的工程化路径
modes.domain_en: The road to the scriptures Wu Cheng'en designed to the number: eighty-one trials, nine nines — not random obstacles but a quota with a total: Guanyin, checking the ledger of trials, finds but eighty and must add one before the perfection is complete. The design's depth: first, growth quantified — cultivation is not a mystical flash but a countable, auditable stair; short by one trial, it does not count. Second, trials serialized — each has its own adversary and its own resolution, the monkey's embassy, the bodhisattva's capture, the master beast claiming its pet; the kinds of trial cover greed, wrath, folly, sloth, doubt, like a timetable deliberately complete. process_en: Set a total for the trials of a long vocation: fix the number first — nine nines — then fill it; a total creates the pressure of completion, and the shortfall itself becomes the drive

representative_cases_en: The audit of the ledger in the ninety-ninth chapter: the bodhisattva finds a trial short and orders one supplied — even the filling of the number has its formal acceptance; the system of trials is thoroughgoing institution

modes.name_en: The Method of Laughter Against the Sacred
modes.category: 方法论/以戏谑完成严肃批判
modes.domain_zh: 《西游记》的底色是笑：玉帝被写成'悚惧'的君主，如来也要被孙悟空叫作'妖精的外甥'式的玩笑所试探，庄严佛事里藏着'要人事'的市侩，取经队伍里连圣人唐僧也常常迂腐可笑；吴承恩的谐谑不是插科打诨，而是一种批判技术：第一，笑声降低防御——被讽刺的对象读到'天帝悚惧'时无法摆出受冒犯的姿态，因为那是玩笑；第二，谐谑是降格操作——把至高者拉到市井尺寸（玉帝怕孙悟空、菩萨的坐骑下界为妖），神圣性一旦可笑就不再不可质疑；第三，笑里藏着最硬的判断——'皇帝轮流做，明年到我家'以玩笑说出了最危险的政治命题；第四，幽默保全作者——谐谑的暧昧性让文本在'游戏笔墨'的保护下完成最尖利的清算；他证明：对不可正面攻击之物，笑声是唯一的攻城锤
modes.domain_en: The ground tone of Journey to the West is laughter: the Jade Emperor written as a monarch who 'quakes', the Buddha himself tried by the monkey's jests, solemn rites hiding the market haggling of 'the gift for the scriptures', and even the holy Tang monk often pedantic and laughable. Wu Cheng'en's humor is not comic relief but a technique of critique: first, laughter lowers defense — the satirized cannot take offense at 'the emperor quaked', for it is a joke. Second, humor is the operation of debasement — the highest is pulled to market scale, the Emperor afraid of a monkey, the bodhisattva's mount gone down to be a demon; once the sacred can be laughed at, it is no longer beyond question. Third, the joke hides the hardest judgment — 'let the emperorship take its turn; next year it comes to my house' speaks the most dangerous political thesis as a pleasantry. Fourth, humor preserves the author — the ambiguity of play lets the text settle its sharpest accounts under the cover of 'an idle pen'. He proved: against what cannot be attacked face on, laughter is the only battering ram
modes.source_chapter: 《西游记》第七回'八卦炉中逃大圣 五行山下定心猿'（'皇帝轮流做'）；第九十八回'要人事'；通篇的谐谑笔法
modes.key_quote_zh: 皇帝轮流做，明年到我家——最危险的政治命题，以玩笑说出
modes.key_quote_en: "Let the emperorship take its turn; next year it comes to my house — the most dangerous political thesis, spoken as a pleasantry."
process_zh: 把要批判的对象拉进喜剧场域：在虚构世界里让至高者做出市井行为（怕事、收礼、护短）——降格即批判
用笑控制批判的剂量：越危险的话越用玩笑说——谐谑的暧昧性是作者与文本的防弹衣
让神圣物自己露出市侩细节：不外加议论，只让'传经要人事'这类细节在情节里自然发生
保持笑与判断的配比：每处戏谑之下压着一条明确的价值判断——纯笑是滑稽，有判断的笑才是讽刺
process_en: Draw the target of critique into the comic field: in the fictional world let the highest do market things — fear, take gifts, shield its own; debasement is the critique
Dose the critique with laughter: the more dangerous the words, the more they must come as a joke — the ambiguity of play is the author's and the text's armor
Let the sacred expose its own market details: no commentary added; let 'the gift for the scriptures' simply happen in the story
Keep the ratio of laughter to judgment: under every jest a clear value judgment — laughter alone is farce; laughter with judgment is satire
representative_cases_zh: '皇帝轮流做，明年到我家'：造反宣言被放进猴子的口中——文本最核心的政治命题以谐谑形式到达读者
'要人事'一节：阿傩伽叶先传无字经，被揭穿后如来引'经不可轻传'自辩并收下紫金钵盂——佛祖亲自示范了体制内的灰色逻辑
猪八戒的贪懒好色被写成笑料而非罪恶：谐谑同时承担宽恕——对人性弱点的批判不取羞辱的姿势
representative_cases_en: 'Let the emperorship take its turn': the declaration of rebellion put into a monkey's mouth — the text's central political thesis reaches the reader in the form of a jest

The asking for 'the gift': Ananda first gives wordless scriptures, is caught, and the Buddha himself pleads 'the scriptures cannot be lightly given' and takes the golden bowl — the Buddha personally demonstrating the gray logic of the institution
Zhu Bajie's greed, sloth and lust written as laughter, not as sin: the humor bears forgiveness too — the critique of human weakness refusing the posture of humiliation
modern_applications_zh: 组织沟通的'谐谑安全通道'：内网漫画、年会小品把流程荒谬演成笑话——玩笑能说到严肃邮件永远到不了的深度
产品文案的降格幽默：把行业黑话和权威姿态降格为市井语言——幽默降低用户防御，说明书写得进脑子
批评上级/客户的'玩笑壳'技术：把核心判断压进一个明显的玩笑里，给对方留台阶也给自己留退路——谐谑的暧昧性是双向缓冲
modern_applications_en: The comic safe channel in organizations: intranet cartoons and year-end skits play the absurdity of process as a joke — a joke reaches depths no serious memo can
Debasing humor in product copy: pull industry jargon and authoritative posture down to market speech — humor lowers the user's defense, and the manual gets in

The joke-shell technique for criticizing up or outward: press the core judgment inside an evident pleasantry, leaving the other a step down and yourself a way back — the ambiguity of play is a two-way buffer

modes.category: 认知方法/以一个角色具象化内心的全部躁动
modes.domain_zh: 孙悟空在文本内部有一个稳定的别名：'心猿'——回目里'心猿归正''心猿空用千般计'反复出现；这个命名是全书的钥匙：第一，一个角色承载一种心理——心猿意马本是中国哲学对散乱心识的古老比喻，吴承恩把它变成一个有人格、有历史、有力量的角色，抽象的'心'从此可被叙事；第二，修行的地图就是人物弧线——大闹天宫是'放心'，五行山下是'定心'，紧箍咒是'拴心'，斗战胜佛是'心成'——取经的外部旅程同时是内部的驯心过程，一鱼两吃；第三，六耳猕猴之难是全书心理学的高峰——假心猿打真心猿，连观音也看不出，谛听听出而不敢说：人心的自我欺骗连神明都难以裁决，最后要靠如来；第四，'心猿'让内省外化——读者不必玄谈心性，只需跟随猴子：他证明：把内部过程铸成一个角色，是让不可见的心智活动变得可观察、可讨论、可传承的技术
modes.domain_en: Within the text Sun Wukong carries a stable other name: 'mind-monkey' — the chapter titles repeat it, the mind-monkey returns to the right, the mind-monkey spends a thousand wiles for nothing. The name is the key to the whole book. First, one character carrying one psychology: mind like a monkey, will like a horse is the old figure for scattered consciousness, and Wu Cheng'en made it a character with person, history and force — the abstract heart becomes narratable. Second, the map of cultivation is the character's arc — havoc in heaven the heart at large, the mountain of five elements the heart stilled, the band-tightening charm the heart tied, the buddha victorious in strife the heart made; the outward journey is at the same time the inward taming, one fish two dishes. Third, the trial of the six-eared macaque is the book's psychological summit — the false mind-monkey striking the true, Guanyin unable to tell, Di Ting hearing and not daring to say: the self-deception of the heart even gods cannot judge, and the Buddha must. Fourth, the mind-monkey externalizes introspection — the reader need not discourse on the nature of mind but only follow the monkey. He proved: casting an inner process as a character is the technique that makes invisible mental life observable, discussable, transmissible
modes.source_chapter: 《西游记》第十四回'心猿归正 六贼无踪'；第七十回'心猿空用千般计'；第五十八回'二心搅乱大乾坤'；第三十回'邪魔侵正法 意马忆心猿'
modes.key_quote_zh: 心猿归正——把'心'铸成一个角色，让不可见的心智活动可观察、可讨论、可传承
modes.key_quote_en: "The mind-monkey returns to the right — cast the heart as a character, and invisible mental life becomes observable, discussable, transmissible."
process_zh: 为要处理的内部状态找一个具象载体：选一个有民族心理基础的意象（心猿意马）——具象物自带文化共识，读者零成本进入
把成长过程写成载体的命运线：躁动期、受制期、驯服期、成就期对应故事的四幕——外部情节与内部历程严格同构
设计'内心冲突的外化副本'：让自我欺骗成为两个一模一样的对手（真假美猴王）——内耗被写成可观看的决斗
给驯服过程留一个持续的装置：紧箍咒——成长不靠一次性顿悟，靠长期在位的约束机制
process_en: Find a concrete carrier for the inner state to be handled: choose an image with folk-psychological depth, the mind like a monkey — the carrier comes with cultural consensus; the reader enters at no cost
Write growth as the carrier's fate: restlessness, restraint, taming, attainment answering the four acts — outward plot and inward course strictly isomorphic
Design an external double for inner conflict: let self-deception become two identical adversaries, the true and false monkey kings; inner friction written as a duel that can be watched
Leave a standing device for the taming: the band-tightening charm — growth comes not from one flash of insight but from a constraint long in place
representative_cases_zh: 第十四回'心猿归正 六贼无踪'：出山第一战打死的六个强盗名叫'眼看喜、耳听怒'——六根六贼被写成一伙剪径的毛贼，佛学概念完成叙事化
真假美猴王：谛听'知怪名却不敢说破'——自我认知的关键一步，连洞察者也选择沉默，人心之谜被推到极限
紧箍咒的功能史：从强制约束到成佛后'自然消失'——最好的自律装置是最终不再被需要的装置
representative_cases_en: Chapter fourteen, the mind-monkey returning, the six thieves gone: the first six bandits slain bear the names 'the eye loves to see', 'the ear burns to hear' — the six senses as a gang of highwaymen, a Buddhist term narrativized
The true and false monkey kings: Di Ting hears and knows and dares not say — the key step of self-knowledge, at which even the all-hearing chooses silence; the riddle of the heart pushed to its limit
The functional history of the band: from forced restraint to vanishing at buddhahood — the best device of self-discipline is the one no longer needed at the end
modern_applications_zh: 给情绪/坏习惯起一个具象名字：'内心戏精''分心猴'——命名即管理，把模糊的感受变成可以对话与训练的对象
把个人成长写成'外部旅程+内部旅程'双线：项目复盘时同时记录'做成了什么'与'驯服了什么'——两线同构才算真成长
为自己设计'紧箍咒'式长期装置：不靠意志力顿悟，靠持续在位的约束（冻结账户、公开承诺、自动扣款）——成事之日装置自然退役
modern_applications_en: Give an emotion or bad habit a concrete name — the drama queen within, the distraction monkey: to name is to manage, turning vague feeling into an object that can be spoken with and trained
Write personal growth as twin journeys, outward and inward: in any retrospective record both what was achieved and what was tamed; the two lines must be isomorphic for growth to be real

Design yourself a band-tightening device of long standing: not willpower's flash but a constraint in place — frozen accounts, public pledges, automatic transfers; the device retires of itself on the day of attainment

modes.definition_en: Within the text Sun Wukong carries a stable other name: 'mind-monkey' — the chapter titles repeat it, the mind-monkey returns to the right, the mind-monkey spends a thousand wiles for nothing. The name is the key to the whole book. First, one character carrying one psychology: mind like a monkey, will like a horse is the old figure for scattered consciousness, and Wu Cheng'en made it a character with person, history and force — the abstract heart becomes narratable. Second, the map of cultivation is the character's arc — havoc in heaven the heart at large, the mountain of five elements the heart stilled, the band-tightening charm the heart tied, the buddha victorious in strife the heart made; the outward journey is at the same time the inward taming, one fish two dishes. Third, the trial of the six-eared macaque is the book's psychological summit — the false mind-monkey striking the true, Guanyin unable to tell, Di Ting hearing and not daring to say: the self-deception of the heart even gods cannot judge, and the Buddha must. Fourth, the mind-monkey externalizes introspection — the reader need not discourse on the nature of mind but only follow the monkey. He proved: casting an inner process as a character is the technique that makes invisible mental life observable, discussable, transmissible

modes.name_en: The Method of Fantasy Writing the Real
modes.category: 认知方法/以超现实设定承载精确的现实观察
modes.domain_zh: 《西游记》的妖魔世界看似胡编，实则处处是精确的世情写真：黄狮精开店卖被盗的兵器还要'公平交易'，狮猁怪冒充乌鸡国王竟把朝政理得井井有条，比丘国祸国的是'美后'与国丈的配合，通天河吃童男童女靠的是'灵感大王'的香火经济——妖怪的行为逻辑全是人间逻辑；这个方法的机理：第一，超自然外壳防止对号入座——读者可以放心地把妖怪认作某类人，因为'妖怪'免责；第二，幻想放大特征——妖的贪嗔痴比人的更极端，被夸张的特征反而更容易辨认，'become metaphor 才看得清'；第三，细节必须取自现实——幻笔的信用来自妖精也要吃饭、行贿、搞人际关系，一旦细节失真整个幻境塌方；第四，批判获得双重受众——儿童看热闹，成人看门道，一个文本两层通吃；他证明：最精确的社会观察常常需要最不现实的包装才能说出口
modes.domain_en: The demon world of Journey to the West seems made up, yet everywhere it is exact portraiture of the world: the yellow lion demon, keeping a shop for stolen weapons, still insists on fair trade; the lion impostor on the throne of the black-rooster kingdom governs the state in good order; the ruin of the kingdom of比丘 comes of a 'fair queen' and the state preceptor acting in concert; the Great King of Inspiration at the River of Heaven lives on an economy of incense, feeding on boys and girls — the demons' logic is everywhere human logic. The mechanism: first, the supernatural shell prevents matching faces — the reader may take a demon as a kind of person in safety, for 'demon' disclaims; second, fantasy magnifies traits — a demon's greed and wrath run more extreme than a person's, and the exaggerated feature is the easier to recognize; the metaphor must be made to be seen clearly. Third, the details must come from the real — the fantasy's credit rests on demons needing to eat, bribe and work their connections; one false detail and the whole幻 collapses. Fourth, the critique gains a double audience — children read the spectacle, adults the mechanism; one text serves both floors. He proved: the most exact social observation often needs the least realistic packaging to be said aloud
modes.source_chapter: 《西游记》第八十九回'黄狮精虚设钉钯宴'；第三十七至三十九回乌鸡国；第七十八至七十九回比丘国；第四十七至四十九回通天河
modes.key_quote_zh: 妖怪的行为逻辑全是人间逻辑——最精确的社会观察，常常需要最不现实的包装才能说出口
modes.key_quote_en: "The demons' logic is everywhere human logic — the most exact social observation often needs the least realistic packaging to be said aloud."
process_zh: 先做扎实的现实观察：把要写的人间现象（贪腐、营销、权力寻租）拆成可复用的行为细节清单
选一个能免责的超自然外壳：妖怪、异界、机器人——外壳让被映射者无法申辩，也让读者敢于辨认
把现实细节原样装进幻想情节：妖精也要经营人脉、给上级送礼——细节的真实度是幻境的承重墙
把特征推到极端以增强可辨性：贪就贪到吃人，骗就骗到一个国——夸张不是失真，是显微镜
process_en: First observe the real closely: break the human phenomenon — corruption, marketing, rent-seeking — into a list of reusable behavioral details
Choose a disclaiming supernatural shell: demons, another world, robots — the shell leaves the mapped unable to answer, and lets the reader dare to recognize
Load the real details unchanged into the fantastic plot: demons too must work connections and send gifts upward — the truth of detail is the load-bearing wall of the fantasy
Push traits to the extreme for legibility: greed to the eating of men, deceit to the winning of a kingdom — exaggeration is not distortion but the microscope
representative_cases_zh: 黄狮精'虚设钉钯宴'：偷了兵器开'钉钯宴'显摆，还派小妖拿银子进城买猪羊、要求找零——妖界一样有消费文化与现金交易
乌鸡国假国王：狮子精顶替国王三年，'国家也不见得坏到哪里'——影射'换谁上位都一样的官僚惯性'
比丘国国丈药方要小儿心肝：以'长生'为名的极端索取——权力欲的隐喻被推到吃人的字面义
representative_cases_en: The yellow lion's feast of the rake: having stolen the weapons he throws an exhibition banquet, sends imps to town with silver for pigs and sheep and asks for the change — the demon world too has consumer culture and cash
The false king of the black-rooster kingdom: a lion on the throne three years, and the state no worse for it — the bureaucratic inertia of 'anyone in the seat, it is the same'
The state preceptor of比丘 with his prescription of children's hearts: extreme extraction in the name of longevity — the metaphor of the will to power pushed to the literal eating of men
modern_applications_zh: 用'世界观外包'做敏感议题表达：职场、医疗、教育的观察装进科幻/奇幻设定发表——免责外壳+真实细节是通行结构
教学与科普的'妖魔化映射'：把组织里的典型角色画成怪物图鉴（审批怪、甩锅精）——夸张让模式可辨认，成人儿童都能看懂
虚构写作的现实主义纪律：设定可以飞，细节必须落地——先建一份'现实行为细节清单'再动笔
modern_applications_en: Worldview outsourcing for sensitive subjects: publish observations of office, medicine, schooling inside sci-fi or fantasy settings — the disclaiming shell plus true detail is the standing structure

Demonized mapping for teaching: draw the typical roles of an organization as a bestiary — the approval beast, the blame-shifting imp; exaggeration makes the pattern recognizable to adults and children alike
The realist discipline of fiction: settings may fly, details must land — build the list of real behavioral details before writing

蒲松龄（以狐鬼写真世情）

刘慈欣（以宇宙尺度写真人性抉择）

modes.name_en: The Method of the Flawed Company
modes.category: 方法论/以互补的缺陷组成可行的团队
modes.domain_zh: 取经队伍是文学史上最著名的'缺陷团队'：唐僧有信念无武力且肉眼识妖、动辄错怪；孙悟空神通广大却傲慢好斗、不服管束；猪八戒能干活、会打圆场，却贪懒好色、动辄散伙；沙僧忠厚可靠却无主见、本事平平——四人都带着不能修复的短板上路；这个设计的深意：第一，团队的成立靠目标而非靠完美——四人无一人'合格'，但'取经'这个目标把所有缺陷变成了分工（信念、武力、润滑、后勤）；第二，缺陷互相制衡——悟空的暴烈被紧箍约束，八戒的散伙论被沙僧劝住，唐僧的错怪最终被事实纠正：制衡系统内生于性格冲突；第三，缺陷即叙事引擎——八戒的贪懒每次都酿成新的难，性格缺陷就是八十一难的内部发动机；第四，完成度高于完美度——佛位评定时悟空成'斗战胜佛'、八戒只封'净坛使者'，缺陷未被消除，只是被岗位匹配了；他证明：可持续的协作不是招募无缺陷的完人，而是让互异缺陷在共同目标下互相咬合
modes.domain_en: The pilgrimage company is literature's most famous team of flaws: the Tang monk has faith but no force, mortal eyes that cannot know a demon, and a habit of wronging the innocent; Sun Wukong is mighty but proud and quarrelsome, ungovernable; Zhu Bajie can work and smooth a quarrel, but is greedy, lazy, lecherous, forever proposing to give up; Sha monk is honest and reliable but without initiative and only moderately able — all four take the road bearing flaws that will not be repaired. The design's depth: first, the team is founded on the goal, not on perfection — not one of the four would 'qualify', yet the goal of the scriptures turns every flaw into a division of labor: faith, force, lubrication, logistics. Second, the flaws check one another — the monkey's violence bound by the band, Bajie's desertion talk talked down by Sha monk, the master's wrongings corrected at last by fact: the balancing system is native to the conflicts of temperament. Third, flaw is the engine of story — Bajie's laziness brews each new trial; character defect is the internal motor of the eighty-one. Fourth, completion over perfection — at the awarding the monkey becomes buddha victorious in strife, Bajie only 'altar cleanser': the flaws are not removed but matched to posts. He proved: lasting collaboration is not recruiting flawless saints, but letting unlike flaws interlock under a common goal
modes.source_chapter: 《西游记》第八回沙僧皈依、第十九回八戒皈依、第三十回'邪魔侵正法 意马忆心猿'、第一百回'径回东土 五圣成真'
modes.key_quote_zh: 四人无一人合格，但'取经'把所有缺陷变成了分工——可持续的协作靠缺陷咬合，不靠完人
modes.key_quote_en: "Not one of the four would qualify, yet the journey turns every flaw into a division of labor — lasting collaboration interlocks flaws; it does not recruit saints."
process_zh: 以共同目标为团队唯一准入条件：不看成员是否'完美'，只看缺陷是否可分工——信念、武力、润滑、后勤各有人认领
把缺陷设计成互相制衡的力：每个成员的短板恰好被另一成员的长板约束——制衡要内生于性格而非外加制度
允许缺陷制造代价并让团队消化：八戒的失误成为剧情燃料——不消灭失误，建立消化失误的机制
按缺陷匹配最终报酬：成佛有高下、封号有巧思——激励对齐岗位而非清一色嘉奖
process_en: Make the common goal the team's sole admission test: ask not whether members are perfect, only whether the flaws can be divided into posts — faith, force, lubrication, logistics, each claimed
Design the flaws as mutually checking forces: each member's weakness constrained by another's strength — the checks native to temperament, not bolted on as rules
Let flaws create cost and let the team digest it: Bajie's errors are the fuel of the plot — do not abolish error; build the mechanism that digests it
Match the final reward to the flaw: buddhahood with ranks, the titles with wit — incentives aligned to posts, not uniform praise
representative_cases_zh: 三打白骨精后的团队危机：唐僧逐走悟空、八戒嚷散伙、沙僧无言——缺陷引发的断裂最终靠'目标与事实'双重拉回，而非靠谁的觉悟
八戒的'分行李'口头禅：散伙论每次都被'大师兄还在'压下——团队里需要一个合法表达退出冲动的角色
第一百回的封号设计：八戒封'净坛使者'因'口壮身慵'正好吃供品——缺陷被岗位化，激励与性格精准对齐
representative_cases_en: The team crisis after the third striking of the White Bone Demon: the master dismisses the monkey, Bajie calls for splitting the luggage, Sha monk is silent — the rupture born of flaws is drawn back by goal and fact together, not by anyone's enlightenment
Bajie's refrain of dividing the baggage: each time talked down by 'the eldest brother is still here' — a team needs one legitimate voice for the impulse to quit

The titles of the hundredth chapter: Bajie made 'altar cleanser', for 'loud of mouth and slow of body' he is just the one to eat the offerings — the flaw given a post, incentive aligned to temperament with precision
modern_applications_zh: 组队时公开化彼此缺陷：用'缺陷清单'代替技能清单做分工——让'谁容易在什么情况下掉链子'成为可管理的公共信息
给团队配置'八戒位'：留一个敢于说'我不干了'和'这样不对'的角色——退出冲动与散伙论有出口，团队才不真正散伙
激励与缺陷对齐：不追求人人同奖，按各自的真实驱动设计回报——'净坛使者'式的人岗匹配比普涨激励稳定
modern_applications_en: Make flaws public at team formation: divide labor by a list of flaws rather than a list of skills — 'who drops what under what strain' becomes managed common knowledge
Assign the Bajie post: keep one voice licensed to say 'I quit' and 'this is wrong' — the impulse to leave must have an exit for the team truly to hold
Align incentives to flaws: not one prize for all, but returns designed to each real drive — the altar-cleanser matching of person to post outlasts any uniform raise

modes.name_en: The Method of the Demon with a Patron
modes.category: 方法论/在情节机制里内嵌社会结构分析
modes.domain_zh: 《西游记》反复上演同一出戏：孙悟空要打死作恶的妖怪，正要下手时，天上来人收走了——金角银角是太上老君的童子，青牛是老君的坐骑，黄眉是弥勒的童子，狮象是菩萨的坐骑——'妖有后台'成为全书的情节规律；这个规律是结构分析而非抱怨：第一，恶行有产权链——妖怪吃人作恶多年无人处置，主人一到即刻收走、责罚全免，'职务之便+主人兜底'是明代权贵家奴现象的精确机制描述；第二，程序正义的边界被写透——悟空的暴击有效于野妖怪，对'有背景的妖怪'程序上就到不了位：暴力解不开产权保护，只能走上级路线（找观音、找老君）；第三，惩罚的不对称被平静呈现——被打死的都是没后台的散妖，被收走的都有来历，文本不评论、只排列，结论由读者自己得出；第四，叙事结构内嵌分析——不是借人物之口发议论，而是让'情节规律'本身成为论据；他证明：让一个社会结构的规律以情节规则的形式反复出现，是最有效的隐性论说文
modes.domain_en: Journey to the West plays one scene again and again: the monkey about to strike the demon dead when someone from heaven takes it away — the golden horn and silver horn are Laozi's boys, the green bull his mount, the yellow-browed the Maitreya's page, the lion and elephant the bodhisattvas' mounts — 'the demon has a patron' is a law of the plot. The law is structural analysis, not complaint. First, evil has a chain of ownership: the demon devours men for years unhandled; the master arrives, takes it off, and the account is cleared — 'office's convenience plus the patron's cover' is an exact mechanism of the great houses' retainers in Ming times. Second, the boundary of procedural justice is written through: the monkey's blows work on the stray demon; against the demon with background the procedure never lands — force cannot open产权 protection; only the superior route remains, to Guanyin, to Laozi. Third, the asymmetry of punishment presented in calm: the beaten dead are all strays without patrons; the taken away all have provenance; the text comments nothing, only arranges, and the reader draws the conclusion. Fourth, analysis embedded in structure — no speech-making through characters' mouths; the law of the plot itself is the argument. He proved: to let a structural law of society recur as a rule of plot is the most effective of implicit essays

modes.key_quote_zh: 被打死的都是没后台的散妖，被收走的都有来历——文本不评论，只排列
modes.key_quote_en: "The beaten dead are strays without patrons; the taken away all have provenance — the text comments nothing, only arranges."
process_zh: 识别目标社会结构的核心规律：谁受罚、谁豁免、豁免的路由是什么——规律先于情节存在
把规律写成情节的重复规则：同构事件反复发生（妖怪→被收走）——单次是偶然，重复即结构
让角色在规则内用尽合法手段：悟空打不死就搬救兵——不走作者开挂的捷径，让读者体验'程序到不了位'的憋屈
全程不评论、只排列：把'死的是散妖、走的是有主的'并排呈现——判断权完整交给读者，结论更不可反驳
process_en: Identify the core law of the target social structure: who is punished, who exempted, and what the route of exemption runs — the law precedes the plot
Write the law as a repeating rule of plot: the same event in the same shape, demon after demon taken off; once is chance, repetition is structure
Let the character exhaust every legal means inside the rule: the monkey unable to kill sends for the patron's master — no authorial cheating; the reader feels the procedure that cannot land
Comment nothing, arrange only: the stray beaten dead and the owned taken away set side by side — the judgment left whole to the reader, the conclusion the harder to rebut
representative_cases_zh: 金角银角之难收尾：老君一句'此乃海上菩萨问我借了三次'——连'设难'都是神仙间的行政协调，受害者只是行程里的耗材
青牛精'金刚琢'套走全部兵器：顶级法宝意味着顶级产权——武力在产权武器面前全部失效，悟空直上灵山找如来'查户口'
凤仙郡对比：无后台的普通郡守求雨要全郡行善三年，有主人的妖怪作恶即刻逍遥——两条线并置完成无声的对照实验
representative_cases_en: The close of the golden and silver horns: Laozi's remark that the bodhisattva 'borrowed' them three times to furnish a trial — even the trial is administrative coordination among immortals, and the sufferers mere consumables of the journey

The green bull's ring that snatches every weapon: the supreme treasure means supreme property — force fails wholly before the weapon of property, and the monkey climbs the mountain to have the Buddha trace the registry

The Fengxian counterpoint: the unowned prefect must wait on a whole prefecture's three years of good works for rain, while the owned demon walks free the moment it is claimed — two lines set together, a silent controlled experiment
modern_applications_zh: 合规分析用'产权链追问'：处理违规时先问'这个东西/这个人归谁兜底'——找不到后台的处罚才有威慑力，找得到的要升级路由
把结构观察写成'重复情节'：案例分析集、内刊讽刺专栏都可用同一母题反复呈现——重复比雄辩更有说服力
调查报告的'零评论排列法'：把两类处置结果并排成表，不加形容词——让数据自己完成论证
modern_applications_en: In compliance work, chase the chain of ownership: when handling a violation ask first who stands surety for this thing or person; punishment without a patron deters, and with one, the route must be escalated
Write structural observation as recurring plot: case collections and satirical columns may present one motif again and again — repetition persuades past eloquence
The zero-commentary arrangement in reports: set the two classes of outcome side by side in a table without adjectives — let the data itself carry the argument

modes.definition_zh: 《西游记》反复上演同一出戏：孙悟空要打死作恶的妖怪，正要下手时，天上来人收走了——金角银角是太上老君的童子，青牛是老君的坐骑，黄眉是弥勒的童子，狮象是菩萨的坐骑——'妖有后台'成为全书的情节规律；这个规律是结构分析而非抱怨：第一，恶行有产权链——妖怪吃人作恶多年无人处置，主人一到即刻收走、责罚全免，'职务之便+主人兜底'是明代权贵家奴现象的精确机制描述；第二，程序正义的边界被写透——悟空的暴击有效于野妖怪，对'有背景的妖怪'程序上就到不了位：暴力解不开产权保护，只能走上级路线（找观音、找老君）；第三，惩罚的不对称被平静呈现——被打死的都是没后台的散妖，被收走的都有来历，文本不评论、只排列，结论由读者自己得出；第四，叙事结构内嵌分析——不是借人物之口发议论，而是让'情节规律'本身成为论据；他证明：让一个社会结构的规律以情节规则的形式反复出现，是最有效的隐性论说文
modes.definition_en: Journey to the West plays one scene again and again: the monkey about to strike the demon dead when someone from heaven takes it away — the golden horn and silver horn are Laozi's boys, the green bull his mount, the yellow-browed the Maitreya's page, the lion and elephant the bodhisattvas' mounts — 'the demon has a patron' is a law of the plot. The law is structural analysis, not complaint. First, evil has a chain of ownership: the demon devours men for years unhandled; the master arrives, takes it off, and the account is cleared — 'office's convenience plus the patron's cover' is an exact mechanism of the great houses' retainers in Ming times. Second, the boundary of procedural justice is written through: the monkey's blows work on the stray demon; against the demon with background the procedure never lands — force cannot open产权 protection; only the superior route remains, to Guanyin, to Laozi. Third, the asymmetry of punishment presented in calm: the beaten dead are all strays without patrons; the taken away all have provenance; the text comments nothing, only arranges, and the reader draws the conclusion. Fourth, analysis embedded in structure — no speech-making through characters' mouths; the law of the plot itself is the argument. He proved: to let a structural law of society recur as a rule of plot is the most effective of implicit essays

modes.name_en: The Method of the Binding Band
modes.category: 方法论/以制度化约束保全长期委托
modes.domain_zh: 紧箍咒是全书最重要的制度设计：观音授计、唐僧持有、悟空受制——一个'驯服最强个体'的问题被它程序化解决；但吴承恩写出了这个制度的全部复杂性：第一，约束源于授权而非暴力——紧箍由观音（更高权威）交付，唐僧只是持咒人，暴力被包装成天命与恩义；第二，约束必然误伤——三打白骨精中紧箍咒连续施用逼走悟空，制度工具在信息不对称下（肉眼识不出妖怪）必然惩罚正确行为；第三，约束有解除条件——灵山脚下'箍自然消失'，制度设计的终点是自我废除：最好的约束以'不再被需要'为成功标准；第四，自愿入箍是隐含前提——悟空皈依时接受游戏规则，约束的合法性来自被约束者的同意；他证明：使用比自己更强的人，必须设计'有解除条件、误伤可承受、基于同意'的约束装置，而不是祈祷对方永远忠诚
modes.domain_en: The band-tightening charm is the book's most important institution: the bodhisattva supplies the spell, the monk holds it, the monkey wears the ring — the problem of taming the strongest individual solved as procedure. Yet Wu Cheng'en writes out the whole complexity of the device: first, restraint comes of delegation, not violence — the band is given by Guanyin, a higher authority; the monk only holds the charm; force dressed as destiny and grace. Second, restraint must wound the innocent — in the striking of the White Bone Demon the charm applied again and again drives the monkey off; an institutional tool under information asymmetry, mortal eyes that cannot know a demon, must punish right conduct too. Third, restraint carries its condition of release — below the mountain of灵山 the band vanishes of itself; the end of institutional design is self-abolition: the best constraint is measured by its becoming unnecessary. Fourth, the willing neck is the implicit premise — the monkey accepted the rules at his conversion; the legitimacy of the constraint lies in the consent of the constrained. He proved: to employ one stronger than yourself you must design a binding device with conditions of release, tolerable error, and consent — not pray for eternal loyalty

modes.key_quote_zh: 最好的约束以'不再被需要'为成功标准——紧箍在灵山自然消失
modes.key_quote_en: "The best constraint is measured by its becoming unnecessary — the band vanishes of itself below the mountain."
process_zh: 约束最强成员时先解决合法性：请更高权威授权、让被约束者同意入局——单靠职位权力拴不住真本事
预设约束的误伤预算：承认制度在信息不全时会惩罚正确行为——配套'事实澄清后的修复机制'（负气出走也要迎回）
写明解除条件与成功标准：约束装置要有自然的终点（目标达成/成员成熟）——把'箍消失'设计进制度而非无限续期
区分'持咒人'与'授权方'：执行约束的人不拥有约束的来源——防止工具被私人滥用
process_en: Settle legitimacy before binding the strongest: higher-authority delegation, and the constrained consenting to the game — position power alone cannot hold real ability

Budget for the constraint's errors: admit the institution will punish right conduct under imperfect information — pair it with a repair mechanism after facts clear (the sulking departure must be followed by a fetching back)
Write the release condition and the success criterion: the device must have a natural end — goal reached, member grown; design the band's vanishing into the institution, not its renewal without end
Separate the holder of the charm from the granter: the one applying restraint does not own its source — the tool is kept from private abuse
representative_cases_zh: 三打白骨精的约束失灵：紧箍咒在信息不对称下连续误伤，最强成员被逼离职——制度工具的失败形态被如实写出
'紧箍儿响'与负气回山：每次误用之后都有'请回'程序——约束体系的修复机制比约束本身更决定团队存续
灵山'箍自然消失'：成佛后悟空伸手摸顶已无箍——制度功成身退的文学原型，成功标准内建于装置
representative_cases_en: The failure at the White Bone Demon: the charm applied under information asymmetry wounds again and again and drives the strongest member to quit — the failure mode of the institutional tool written as it happens
The ringing band and the sulk return: after every misuse there follows the fetching back — the repair mechanism of the binding system decides the team's survival more than the binding itself

The band vanishing at the mountain: buddha now, the monkey's hand to his crown finds no ring — the literary archetype of the institution retiring on success, the success standard built into the device
modern_applications_zh: 给明星员工/合伙人设计'有解除条件的约定'：竞业、对赌、否决权都写明到期与达成条件——约束的可退出性是它可持续的前提
董事会/风控的'授权链设计'：执行约束者不拥有约束来源（持咒人≠授权方），防止约束工具被私人恩怨劫持
制度误伤的'迎回程序'：KPI、竞业、保密协议必然错伤正确行为——预先写好事实澄清后的修复与补偿流程
modern_applications_en: Design agreements with release conditions for star performers and partners: non-competes, earn-outs, vetoes all written with expiry and attainment — the exitability of a constraint is the premise of its lasting
Chain-of-delegation design for boards and risk control: the one applying restraint does not own its source, holder and granter separate, lest the tool be hijacked by private grievance
A fetching-back procedure for institutional misfire: KPIs and non-competes will wound right conduct — write the repair and compensation process in advance, for after the facts clear

modes.name_en: The Method of the Loose Rope of Episodes
modes.category: 方法论/以极简主轴承载海量独立模块
modes.domain_zh: 《西游记》一百回是典型的'珠串式'长篇：除了'取经'四个字，各难之间几乎可以自由增删调序（世德堂本之外还有简本、删本长期并行流通）；但全书又散而不乱，秘密在三个扣件：第一，主轴极简且不可逆——从东土到灵山是单向里程，任何难都无法逆转总方向，'走到哪了'永远可问；第二，角色关系恒定——师徒四人+白龙马的关系矩阵在一切难中不变，读者带着熟悉的'关系载具'进入任何陌生章节；第三，能力守恒——悟空的本事有明确的上下限（打不过某些妖怪、要搬救兵），能力不随剧情需要膨胀，妖怪强度成为衡量进度的隐形刻度；这个方法证明：模块化不等于碎片化——只要主轴不可逆、关系恒定、能力守恒，海量独立模块就能被三根绳子串成一个可以局部替换、整体不散的体系
modes.domain_en: A hundred chapters make Journey to the West the classic string of beads: beyond the two words 'fetch the scriptures' the trials can be added, cut, and reordered almost freely — abridged editions long circulated beside the full one. Yet the whole hangs together, and the secret is in three clasps. First, the spine minimal and irreversible — from the eastern land to the western mountain the mileage runs one way; no trial can reverse the general direction, and 'how far have we come' can always be asked. Second, the relations constant — the matrix of master and three disciples and the white horse unchanged through every trial; the reader rides a familiar vehicle of relations into any strange chapter. Third, the powers conserved — the monkey's might has stated bounds, he cannot beat certain demons and must send for help; his strength never swells to suit the plot, and the strength of demons becomes the hidden gauge of progress. The method proves that modularity is not fragmentation: so long as the spine is irreversible, the relations constant, and the powers conserved, a mass of independent modules can be strung by three cords into a system that can be altered in part and never falls apart in whole
modes.source_chapter: 《西游记》全书结构；第十三回'陷虎穴金星解厄'起取经正篇；世本、简本、朱本、杨本的版本流通史
modes.key_quote_zh: 主轴不可逆、关系恒定、能力守恒——三根绳子串起一百回而不散
modes.key_quote_en: "The spine irreversible, the relations constant, the powers conserved — three cords string a hundred chapters and it does not fall apart."
process_zh: 把长程工作压缩为一句不可逆的主轴：主轴要短到不会忘、方向单一不可回头——这是所有模块的公共坐标系
冻结关系矩阵：参与者的角色、称谓、协作方式全程不变——关系是读者/协作者的载具，比情节本身更需要稳定
为能力设守恒律：核心能力有上下限且不随需求膨胀——用对手强度做进度的隐形刻度，防止体系通胀
让模块可增删调序：单模块自成起讫（遇魔—斗—解）——体系的弹性来自局部可替换，而非整体重来
process_en: Compress the long work into one irreversible spine: short enough never to forget, single in direction, no turning back — the common coordinate system of all modules
Freeze the matrix of relations: roles, names, modes of collaboration constant throughout — relations are the reader's vehicle, needing stability more than the plot itself
Set a conservation law for ability: core powers with stated bounds that never swell to suit the need — the strength of adversaries the hidden gauge of progress, and the system kept from inflation
Let modules admit addition, deletion, reordering: each self-contained, demon met, fought, resolved — the system's elasticity lies in parts replaceable, never in starting the whole again
representative_cases_zh: 明清简本可直接删去数十难仍成立：证明各难是真正的独立模块——删改不伤主轴，这是珠串结构的市场验证
'走到哪了'随时可答：按妖怪层级（野妖→有主之妖→佛道亲传）能判断取经进度——能力守恒让结构自带进度条
师徒关系一百回不变：唐僧念咒、八戒拱火、沙僧劝和、悟空兜底——关系矩阵成了读者进入任何一章的通行证
representative_cases_en: The Ming abridgments could drop dozens of trials and still stand: proof the trials are truly independent modules — cutting harms not the spine, the market's own validation of the string

'How far have we come' always answerable: by the hierarchy of demons, stray, owned, the direct disciples of buddha and dao, the progress of the journey can be read — the conservation of power gives the structure its own progress bar
The relations unchanged through a hundred chapters: the master chants, Bajie stirs, Sha monk soothes, the monkey settles — the matrix of relations the reader's pass into any chapter whatever
modern_applications_zh: 长周期项目的'三扣件'设计：总目标（不可逆）+协作规范（恒定）+资源守恒（不随需求膨胀）——中途换人换模块不伤整体
系列内容生产的珠串法：每个单元自成起讫可独立消费，但共享主轴与人设矩阵——单集可跳看、全集有意义
知识库的模块化原则：单篇自洽、可局部更新，但'主轴页+人物页+能力边界页'三类枢纽页冻结管理
modern_applications_en: The three clasps for long projects: one irreversible goal, constant norms of collaboration, conserved resources that never swell to suit demand — people and modules may change midstream without harm to the whole
The string-of-beads method for serial content: each unit self-contained and consumable alone, sharing the spine and the matrix of characters — any episode may be skipped, the whole still meaningful
The modular principle for a knowledge base: each piece self-consistent and locally updatable, with three classes of hub pages — spine, characters, bounds of ability — frozen under management

Second, the relations constant — the matrix of master and three disciples and the white horse unchanged through every trial; the reader rides a familiar vehicle of relations into any strange chapter. Third, the powers conserved — the monkey's might has stated bounds, he cannot beat certain demons and must send for help; his strength never swells to suit the plot, and the strength of demons becomes the hidden gauge of progress. The method proves that modularity is not fragmentation: so long as the spine is irreversible, the relations constant, and the powers conserved, a mass of independent modules can be strung by three cords into a system that can be altered in part and never falls apart in whole

modes.name_en: The Method of the Three Teachings in One Current
modes.category: 认知方法/在不同价值体系间建立可运行的混合框架
modes.domain_zh: 《西游记》的思想底色是'三教合一'：悟空的师父菩提祖师住在'灵台方寸山，斜月三星洞'——道家的方术、佛家的空观、儒家的进退在他一人身上；取经本身是佛家事业，护法神将却出自道教系统（玉帝、老君、天兵），而孙悟空的精神内核是儒家的'忠义'与士人的傲骨；吴承恩不做三教辨析，而是让三教在同一情节机器里协作运转：第一，各教提供不同功能件——道家出法宝与丹药，佛家出方向与救赎，儒家出伦理与秩序，像分属不同供应商的零件装进同一台机器；第二，冲突被喜剧化处理而非教义裁决——孙悟空骂'老君'、调侃如来，三教之间不辩论只协作；第三，'合'的落点是实践而非教理——取经需要什么就用什么，实用主义是三教的接口协议；第四，给读者留出自由——文本不断言哪一教为高，混合框架本身就是对独断论的处理；他证明：面对互不统属的价值体系，不必裁决高下，可以为它们设计一个共同的项目让它们分工运转
modes.domain_en: The thought of Journey to the West runs on the union of the three teachings: the monkey's master the Bodhi ancestor dwells at the Mountain of the Platform of the Mind, the Cave of the Slanting Moon and Three Stars — daoist arts, the buddhist view of emptiness, the confucian advances and retreats, all in one person; the pilgrimage itself is a buddhist undertaking, yet its guardian host comes from the daoist system — the Jade Emperor, Laozi, the heavenly soldiers — and the monkey's core is confucian loyalty and the scholar's proud bone. Wu Cheng'en does not adjudicate the three teachings; he sets them working together inside one plot machine. First, each teaching supplies different components — the dao the talismans and elixirs, the buddha the direction and the redemption, the confucian the ethic and the order: parts from different suppliers assembled in one engine. Second, conflict is comicized, not settled by doctrine — the monkey reviles Laozi and teases the Buddha; the three teachings never debate, only collaborate. Third, the union lands on practice, not doctrine — the journey takes whatever works; pragmatism is the interface protocol of the three. Fourth, freedom left to the reader — the text never rules which teaching is highest; the mixed frame is itself its handling of dogmatism. He proved: facing value systems under no common roof, one need not rule between them — design them one common project and let them divide the work

modes.key_quote_zh: 道家出法宝，佛家出方向，儒家出伦理——三教不辩论，只协作
modes.key_quote_en: "The dao supplies the talismans, the buddha the direction, the confucian the ethic — the three teachings never debate; they collaborate."
process_zh: 给互不统属的体系各派一个功能位：不做教义比较，只问'这个项目里谁出什么零件'——功能分工取代价值排序
把体系间冲突喜剧化或悬置：不设'裁判局'，让冲突在具体情节里被实用性吸收（需要谁的法宝就找谁）
确定实用的接口协议：合流的落点是共同项目而非统一理论——'取经成功'就是三教的兼容标准
保留解释的自由度：框架不断言谁高谁低——混合本身是对独断的处理，读者自行取用
process_en: Assign each unallied system a functional post: no comparison of doctrines, only 'in this project who supplies what part' — division of labor in place of ranking of worth
Comicize or suspend the conflicts between systems: no bench of judges; let usefulness absorb the clash inside concrete plot — need a talisman, go to its keeper
Fix the pragmatic interface protocol: the union lands on a common project, not a unified theory — 'the scriptures fetched' is the compatibility standard of the three
Preserve the reader's freedom of interpretation: the frame never rules which is higher — the mixture itself is the handling of dogmatism, each reader takes what serves
representative_cases_zh: 菩提祖师的身份设计：讲道'说一会道，讲一会禅，三家配合'，门派不明而法力俱全——混合体系的人格化原型
车迟国斗法：佛道相争由'斗'解决而非'辩'解决——祈雨、坐禅、隔板猜物，体系竞争被翻译成可计分的项目比试
取经路上的资源调度：缺兵器找老君系统的救兵，缺出路找观音，法治秩序喊玉帝——接口协议在每一次求援中运行
representative_cases_en: The design of the Bodhi ancestor: 'now of the way, now of zen, the three schools together', school unnamed, arts complete — the personified prototype of a mixed system

The contest at the cart-slow kingdom: the buddhist-daoist quarrel settled by contest, not by disputation — rain-making, meditation, guessing through a board; competition between systems translated into a scored trial of projects
The logistics of the road: short a weapon, summon the host of Laozi; short a way out, seek Guanyin; for order, cry to the Jade Emperor — the interface protocol running in every summons
modern_applications_zh: 跨学科团队的功能位分配：不争论哪个学科'更根本'，按项目需求给每个学科定供件（工程出可行性、设计出体验、法务出边界）
个人知识体系的'接口协议'：同时持有互不兼容的思想流派（如 X 学派与 Y 学派），只在'做具体决策'时调用——实用主义做兼容层
组织价值观合流：并购或联盟双方文化不融合就先'协作'——共同项目是文化差异的最快接口
modern_applications_en: Functional posting for interdisciplinary teams: no dispute over which discipline is fundamental; by the project's need assign each its part — engineering the feasible, design the experience, legal the boundary
An interface protocol for a personal knowledge system: hold incompatible schools at once, invoking each only when a concrete decision is made — pragmatism as the compatibility layer
The confluence of values in organizations: where merger or alliance cultures will not fuse, let them collaborate first — a common project is the fastest interface between cultures
